items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Who is Helen Jackson? Helen Jackson was a piano player. She lives on East Street. My father was supposed to marry her mother, but he didn't marry his other lady, so she was a wonderful piano player, but she doesn't play anymore now.

ctx.x: Yeah. Who is Helen Jackson? Helen Jackson was a piano player. She lives on East Street. My father was supposed to marry her mother, but he didn't marry his other lady, so she was a wonderful piano player, but she doesn't play anymore now. She's in bad health.
Oh, yeah? Yeah. Well, that's too bad. Yeah. Certainly, yeah. Did she play by ear or read?
